Glossary
Diarrhea Deﬁned as either a decrease in stool consistency or an increase in stool frequency and volume
Enteric nervous system The ENS operates both in conjunction with and independent of the peripheral nervous system
Inﬂammatory bowel disease A chronic inﬂammatory condition of unclear etiology, categorized by location, extent, severity of
disease, in addition to being a strictly mucosal process vs. a transmural process
Polyps Intestinal polyps are intraluminal protuberant tumors characterized by their gross morphological appearance,
location(s), numbers, size, and presence (pedunculated) or absence (sessile) of the stalk
Prebiotics Naturally occurring nutrients that support the intestinal microbiome
Probiotics Bacteria present in nature and in naturally fermented foods that have beneﬁts for the host following ingestion
